identity.name: Habari Stays
identity.mission: Fusion of Tanzanian warmth with high-precision SaaS utility.
identity.theme_strategy: Light Mode Dominant with 'Savannah Luxury' accents for Travelers, and 'Tactical Clarity' for Cashiers.

rules: Use 'Outfit' for all headings to give a modern, tech-forward African feel.
Use 'Inter' for all data tables, inputs, and long-form text for maximum legibility.
Uppercase labels must use tracking-widest (0.1em) and text-xs.

secondary.description: Savannah Gold - Warmth, Action, Tanzanian Sun

accent.description: Maasai Red - Alerts, Highlights, Cultural nod

buttons.primary: bg-[#0F4C5C] text-white hover:bg-[#0A3844] rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all shadow-lg shadow-[#0F4C5C]/20 active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-[#E3B505] text-[#1A1A1A] hover:bg-[#C9A004] rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all
buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#0F4C5C] text-[#0F4C5C] hover:bg-[#0F4C5C]/5 rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.ghost: text-[#0F4C5C] hover:bg-[#0F4C5C]/5 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium

cards.hotel_card: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 border border-border/50
cards.dashboard_widget: bg-white rounded-xl border border-border p-6 shadow-sm
cards.pos_item: bg-white rounded-lg border border-border p-4 hover:border-[#0F4C5C] cursor-pointer transition-all active:bg-[#0F4C5C]/5

inputs.default: rounded-lg border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#0F4C5C] focus-visible:ring-offset-2
inputs.search_hero: h-14 rounded-full border-0 shadow-xl pl-6 pr-32 text-lg

images.alt: Modern City Hotel Dar es Salaam

icons.instruction: Use Lucide React for all standard UI icons. Use explicit SVG components for payment logos (M-Pesa, Airtel Money) if not available in libraries.

sections: Hero: Full height, safari/beach image slider, centralized search bar (Location, Dates, Guests).
Featured Hotels: Horizontal scroll or Grid of Hotel Cards.
Why Choose Us: 3-column feature list with icons.

owner_dashboard.layout: Sidebar Navigation (left), Top Bar (User Profile), Main Content Area.

cashier_pos.layout: Split Screen. Left: 2/3 Order/Room Selection. Right: 1/3 Current Bill & Payment.
features: Large touch-friendly category tabs (Rooms, Food, Services).

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text, only for backgrounds or buttons.
Use 24px-32px padding inside cards to avoid cramping.
Ensure all interactive elements have a hover state.
For tables, use zebra striping or hover rows for readability.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Use Shadcn UI components but override the font and border radius (0.5rem).

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise overlay on solid backgrounds to reduce digital flatness (optional).
